title: Find the directions of greatest spread
brief: Centre a cloud, measure the variance and the kept and lost parts along a line, then read every direction from the SVD and the covariance eigendecomposition.
hints: center returns both the centred data and the mean you subtracted: X.mean(axis=0), then X - mean.
variance_along: scores = Xc @ u, then scores @ scores / (n - 1).
shadow_split: kept = sum of squared scores. For lost, subtract each shadow from its point with Xc - np.outer(scores, u), then sum the squares of what is left.
np.linalg.svd returns V transposed. The components are Vt[:k].T, the scores are Xc @ components, and explained_variance is s[:k] ** 2 / (n - 1).
np.linalg.eigh returns eigenvalues smallest first. Reverse both the eigenvalues and the columns of the eigenvectors, then keep k.
explained_variance_ratio: s = np.linalg.svd(Xc, compute_uv=False), then s ** 2 / np.sum(s ** 2). Keep all min(n, d) values.
